title: Chough records and SpecSync verification make each other stale
symptom: Uncommitted .chough/ stales SpecSync verification; committing .chough/ forces another change check; lifecycle commits stale Chough observations
trigger: Normal cases run, commit, change check, review, finalize sequence
expected: Each tool ignores the other's bookkeeping, and the documented order needs one verification
actual: Three re-verifications and a stash were needed in the Raven run
steps: chough cases run; specsync change review

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: SpecSync bookkeeping and .chough interplay, beyond the revision salt in #10
Reproduced before the fix by the new tests; see .chough/artifacts/bug-0016-reproduction.log.
status: open -> verified. Fixed in 4bf46da; the reproduction tests pass at e806f78 (.chough/artifacts/bug-0016-fixed-reproduction.log).

The reproduction was a test-log observation recorded with evidence add before the fix, not a case-run observation: the regression case definitions TC-cli-0070 to TC-cli-0072 arrived with the fix commit 4bf46da, so they could not run at the unfixed tip. This note links their current passing case-run observations at the review-fix head.

status: verified -> open. Reopened as GitHub #12 recurred: an untracked evidence receipt at check --commit staled a clean clone (spec-sync #1045, 2026-11-11), and checkpoints written after check --commit staled verification on #212. Red on 0.5.0: TC-records-doctor-names-missing-exclusions failed on leif/0.6.0-12-red at c5c3bc14 (doctor names no missing exclusion; next never says when writes are safe). Fixed in the 0.6.0 change (PR #238, REQ-records-014): the three record folders go in SpecSync's verification_ignored_paths, doctor and next say when they are missing, with real-SpecSync tests for both repros.
